An '''iron pickaxe''' is the [[Iron equipment|iron]] [[Tools#Pickaxe|pickaxe]], crafted from three [[iron ingot]]s and two sticks. It is the first pickaxe that can harvest every ore in the pack, including diamond ore and [[native gold]], but not obsidian.

== Usage ==

=== Mining ===
The iron pickaxe breaks pickaxe blocks at speed 7, one faster than the [[copper pickaxe]] and the vanilla iron pickaxe, and has 500 durability, twice vanilla's 250.

Obsidian, crying obsidian and ender chests break at speed 3 and drop nothing.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/tags/block/non_mineable/iron.json}}</ref> A [[diamond pickaxe]] (or an iron or [[steel dolabra]]) is needed to collect them.

The pack also makes glass, glass panes, glowstone, sea lanterns and mob heads pickaxe blocks.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/pickaxe.json}}</ref>

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Hp|4}} damage at an attack speed of 1.2.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[iron ingot]]s. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting and smithing ===
{{Uses}}

In a [[blast furnace]] it melts down into a single iron ingot, and at a [[smithing table]] it takes [[steel alloy]] to become its [[Steel equipment|steel]] counterpart.
